mcp.instructions: Read-only access to the owner's Binance P2P orders and AFIP invoices: list_orders and list_invoices for one month, and monthly_income for the invoiced/sold ARS summary. All three take month as YYYY-MM and return plain ARS numbers. There are NO write tools — invoicing runs via CLI/cron only. Every response includes tableFreshness (age in days of the newest fetched order): the Binance fetch only runs on the owner's machine, so a high ageDays means the table is stale and income figures under-report — flag that instead of trusting the numbers.
